_comment: Adeptus Astartes army rule + Gladius Task Force detachment rule citations (10e). Oath of Moment is the codex-wide army rule (every chapter): pick an enemy unit each Command phase, re-roll all hits AND all wounds against it until the next Command phase. Combat Doctrines is the Gladius Task Force detachment-rule: utility-only movement exemptions per round (Devastator R1 = shoot after Advance / Tactical R2 = shoot + charge after Fall Back / Assault R3+ = charge after Advance). Both gate on code.factions.is_marine_faction(attacker.profile.faction); Doctrines additionally requires Army.resolve_detachment().name == 'Gladius Task Force'. Iter-9 audit (May 2026) corrected the previous fabricated +1-to-wound implementation.

simulator.oath_of_moment.quoted_text: At the start of your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack against your chosen enemy unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
simulator.oath_of_moment.trigger: any ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army (any chapter codex; covered by code.factions.is_marine_faction) makes an attack against the enemy unit chosen at the start of your most recent Command phase
simulator.oath_of_moment.effect: re-roll the Hit roll AND re-roll the Wound roll (any failure, not just 1s). Battle._pick_oath_target picks the highest live-weighted-threat alive enemy unit each Command phase (score = points_cost * current_health / max_health, with a rotate-off-prior-anchor tiebreak when a runner-up is within 50% of the top score) and stores its uid on army.oath_target_uid; Unit.attack sets att_reroll_all_hits = att_reroll_all_wounds = True when attacker is a Marine and own_army.oath_target_uid == target.uid. Both re-roll branches take priority over the 1s-only flags; a die that re-rolled here does not re-roll again under reroll_hit_ones / reroll_wound_ones / Twin-Linked.

simulator.combat_doctrines.quoted_text: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Devastator Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
simulator.combat_doctrines.trigger: an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from an army with the Gladius Task Force detachment attempts to shoot or charge in a turn in which it Advanced (R1/R3+) or Fell Back (R2). SwegHammer's AI rotates deterministically: round 1 Devastator, round 2 Tactical, round 3+ Assault.
simulator.combat_doctrines.effect: Lifts the matching 10e core-rule lockout. Devastator (R1): simulator._do_shoot allows the Marine unit to shoot through the advanced_this_round set (parallel to [ASSAULT] / Mont'ka / Battle Focus). Tactical (R2): simulator._do_shoot and simulator._do_charge both allow the Marine unit to act after Fall Back even without FLY. Assault (R3+): simulator._do_charge allows the Marine unit to declare a charge after Advancing. Gating helper Battle._gladius_active_doctrine() faction-checks via code.factions.is_marine_faction and detachment-checks via Army.resolve_detachment().name == 'Gladius Task Force' (Ironstorm Spearhead Marines get nothing here). No wound / hit / damage modifier — utility only. Iter-9 audit (May 2026) replaced the fabricated +1-to-wound implementation.

simulator.astartes_ranged_hold.rule_name: Advancing (10e Core Rules) + [ASSAULT] weapon ability — Adeptus Astartes gunline piloting heuristic
simulator.astartes_ranged_hold.quoted_text: A unit that Advances can't shoot or declare a charge later this turn. ... [ASSAULT]: If a unit made a Normal move, Advanced or Fell Back this turn, its models can still make ranged attacks with weapons they are equipped with that have the [ASSAULT] ability when this unit is selected to shoot.
simulator.astartes_ranged_hold.trigger: SWEG_ASTARTES_RANGED_HOLD default-OFF screening gate ('1' opt-in; unset/'0' is the byte-identical off path); a moving Adeptus Astartes unit seeking an objective (CAPTURE/STEAL intent), carrying no [ASSAULT] weapon and no transient [ASSAULT] grant, with ranged damage per activation >= 2.0 and weapon range >= 18 inches, that has a damageable target within a Normal move's reach.
simulator.astartes_ranged_hold.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; grounds in the core-rules fact that Advancing forfeits non-[ASSAULT] shooting. The SAME logic as simulator.am_advance_discipline / simulator.ck_ranged_hold / simulator.votann_ranged_hold / simulator.tsons_ranged_hold / simulator.soror_ranged_hold / simulator.tyranids_ranged_hold (an eighth entry point _ad_astartes on the shared _suppress_advance block in code/simulator.py _do_move), restricted to Adeptus Astartes: its dedicated fire platforms hold and shoot instead of Advancing and forfeiting their Shooting phase. Derived from watched pilot-observation (2026-07-03, docs/PILOT_FINDINGS.md): across three piloted games (Chaos Knights seed 0, Orks seed 1, Necrons seed 2) the Marine non-[ASSAULT] fire platforms Advanced their opening rounds and marched the line forward into the enemy; in the Orks melee-horde game (seed 1) this fed a 6-67 blow-out — the gunline was ground up in melee while the two Repulsors that HELD killed 16 and 19 Boyz per activation — and versus Necrons (seed 2) the Eradicator Squads (Melta Rifles, ranged damage per activation 2.24, range 18 inches, non-[ASSAULT]) Advanced round 2 (the Tactical Doctrine round, which lifts only the Fall-Back lockout, not the Advance lockout) forfeiting their Shooting phase, then dealt an Overlord 6 and a Ghost Ark 5 once held rounds 3-4. Oath of Moment (army.oath_of_moment) and the Gladius Combat Doctrines (simulator.combat_doctrines: Devastator R1 shoot-after-Advance, Tactical R2 act-after-Fall-Back, Assault R3+ charge-after-Advance) are ALREADY modelled and verified firing in the replays — the deficit is the mis-pilot, not a missing rule. SIM-DATA FINDING (scripts/diag_astartes_filter.py): the army's premier gun infantry, the Hellblaster Squad, is flagged [ASSAULT] in the catalogue, so it already shoots after Advancing and is correctly excluded by the shared `not attacker.profile.assault` guard — it is never held. ROSTER-FILTER AUDIT (scripts/diag_astartes_filter.py): the rDPA >= 2.0 & range >= 18 inch filter holds 73 catalogue units, every one a dedicated fire platform (Repulsor, Predator, Vindicator, Gladiator/Ballistus/Redemptor, Land Raiders, Whirlwind, Desolation, Devastator, Eradicator, Eliminator, Suppressor) or a ranged CHARACTER (Captain, Lieutenant, Librarian, Techmarine — the analog of the Thousand Sons psyker and Sororitas Morvenn Vahl holds), and holds NONE of the core bolter or assault infantry (Intercessors rDPA 1.67, Tactical Squad 1.95, Assault Intercessors 0.73, Scouts, plus every [ASSAULT] unit — Hellblasters, Inceptors, Heavy Intercessors, Terminator Assault, Vanguard, Bladeguard), so the swarm-of-bodies forward pressure onto objectives is untouched and the filter needs no infantry narrowing. Off path (SWEG_ASTARTES_RANGED_HOLD unset) byte-identical to the pre-change baseline. Screen N=20 Adeptus-Astartes-scoped paired vs the sc52a anchor is the deciding measurement.
